opportunities.name: Company account brief email
opportunities.description: For a given ticker/company, look up the latest 10-K on SEC EDGAR, get HQ/employees/CEO from Wikipedia, and draft an account brief email to a recipient.
steps: Search ticker on SEC EDGAR and open the company filings
Open Form 10-K annual report and note the filing date
Search company name on Wikipedia and read HQ, employees, CEO
Compose email to recipient with subject 'Account brief: <Company> (<Ticker>)'
Type body summarizing HQ, employees, CEO, latest 10-K date

instances.values: HUBS started (SEC 10-K lookup), not completed in view

opportunities.name: Supplier quote currency comparison email
opportunities.description: Convert two currency amounts to USD on Xe, check local time in the supplier city on timeanddate, and email the comparison to procurement.
steps: Enter amount A and currency A, convert to USD
Enter amount B and currency B, convert to USD
Search supplier city on timeanddate World Clock and read local time
Compose email to procurement with subject 'Quotes: <item>' and body with both conversions, cheaper option, and supplier local time

instances.values: 12500 EUR vs 1950000 JPY, Osaka, CNC enclosures
8200 GBP vs 780000 INR, Pune, Shipping boxes

opportunities.name: Timezone and holiday sync email
opportunities.description: Compare time difference between two cities on timeanddate, find holidays of a country in a month, and email ops with sync guidance.
steps: Open Calendar > Holidays, choose country and month
Compose email to ops with subject 'Sync: <city1> / <city2>, <month>' and body with offset and dates to avoid

instances.values: San Francisco / Bangalore, India, October, avoid Oct 2 and 20
